newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Mitsuzuka says dollar to settle down soon.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Mitsuzuka says dollar to settle down soon.

text.p: The dollar is likely to settle down soon as the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations' statement on foreign exchange rates is digested by foreign exchange markets, Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told reporters on Monday.
Asked about Monday's rapid rise of the yen against the dollar, Mitsuzuka said:
"I think the message of the G7 nations' agreement on foreign exchange rates is gradually getting through to the market."
Asked about earlier reports that he had said he expected the dollar exchange rate to settle down, he said:
"As a result of the message getting through, it will settle down soon."
